item.summary: Huddlestock Fintech AS has signed a letter of intent with the crypto exchange Firi for a tied-agent solution using Huddlestock's regulatory infrastructure, according to a stock-exchange notice published on 18 November 2026. The notice describes the arrangement as a letter of intent, not a completed agreement, and says the collaboration remains subject to further commercial, operational and regulatory assessment. Firi would, as planned, become a tied agent under Huddlestock's licence; the release describes Firi as the largest crypto exchange in the Nordics, with about 430,000 retail customers in Norway, Sweden and Denmark.
